title: Equivalent Fractions - Same Size
objective: Recognize and show that equivalent fractions have the same size, though not necessarily the same shape.

problems.text: Label what fraction of each shape is shaded. Then, circle the fractions that are equal.
Label the shaded fraction. Draw 2 different representations of the same fractional amount.
Ann has 6 small square pieces of paper. 2 squares are grey. Ann cuts the 2 grey squares in half with a diagonal line from one corner to the other.

sub_problems.question: What shapes does she have now?
How many of each shape does she have?
